answers.how: The shark is approximately 411 pixels long and moves about 640 pixels/s. Its length is (411/640) × 7 ≈ 4.5 m.
The shark moves straight in one direction over 47/24 seconds, giving a displacement of 7 × (47/24) ≈ 13.71 m.
